title: FIFA Football 2005
statusNote: EA Sports logo, FIFA licence screen, title, favourite-team prompt, main menu, a friendly (Arsenal v Tottenham): the teams walk out and the match plays in 3D with minimap, pause menu and instant replay.
notes: The first screen asks for a favourite team: 5 picks the one shown, 9 means no favourite. Either way a confirmation follows with Cancel preselected; move up to Ok and press 5.
Menus show their own key hints: 5 selects (OK works too in most menus), 7 goes back.
Left idle on the first screens, the game starts a demo match; a soft key leaves it for the main menu.

Multiplayer (Bluetooth, Host or Join in the main menu's Multiplayer): the joining player picks the host from the list, the host accepts and presses Connect, and both choose a side and a team. A match starts, but the joining player's game then loses the connection, so a match cannot be played yet. N-Gage Arena is no longer online.

multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room connect: one chooses Host, the other Join and the host in the list, the host accepts and presses Connect; sides and teams are chosen on shared screens and a match starts on both. Then the joining game shows "Waiting for connection" over the match and ends with "Connection Lost" (once at kick-off, once at half-time); the host is not told and its match runs on alone.

controls.source: The game's own Game Controls diagrams (Defending and Attacking), shown before kick-off. Moving, pass, instant replay and the pause menu were confirmed in a match.

actions.left: Move player; change a menu value
actions.right: Move player; change a menu value
actions.7: Pass, hold for a one-two; switch player, hold for keeper charge; back (menus)

notes: Football layout: move on the arrows; A sprints, S passes, D shoots, F lobs, E plays a through ball, R shows the replay; Escape opens the pause menu.
On a gamepad A shoots and selects, B passes and goes back, X lobs, Y plays a through ball, the right shoulder or trigger sprints, the left shoulder shows the replay, Start pauses.
